data_fields.name: battle_amount_by_rank_and_stat
data_fields.donor_constant: E: 5 (win streak) to 500 (damage stats); S: 10 (win streak) to 2000 (damage stats)

best_idea: A three-slot bounty board that is recomputed, not stored, from (player id hash, completed count), with each bounty judged at game end from that game's own maxima and the count as the only stored number.
decision_why: Frankendom wants server-verified side goals with one stored number per player; the stateless board plus per-game maxima gives that. Replace the placeholder uid hash with a seeded hash, keep the count separate from the slot level, and make the event window a zone setting.
acceptance: A player sees three bounties that change only after one completes; a server test asserts the same (uid, count) gives the same three bounties, a battle bounty is judged from the match's own maxima at game end, and slot 0's rank rises only with the count.
